sentences.text:
Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Writ Petition No.20148 Of 2024
Order:

Heard learned Counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 to 4, Sri P. Sri Harsha Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for Singareni Collieries Limited appearing on behalf of respondent No.5, Sri P. Lakshma Reddy, learned Counsel appearing for respondent Nos.7, 9, 10, 13, 14, 16, 18, 20, 21, 22 and 23 and perused the record.
2.

The case of the petitioners, in brief, is that the respondent authorities by issuing preliminary notification dated 25.05.2023 and declaration dated 25.08.2023 under Section 19 of Right to Fair Compensation, and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the Act') are seeking to acquire various extents of lands in Goleti village, Rebenna Mandal, Komurambheem-Asifabad District.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation, and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Petitioners further contend that though the respondent authorities have issued notice under Section 21 of the Act on 03.01.2024 directing the persons interested to appear before the Authority on 10.01.2024 and even though the petitioners have appeared on the said date, no Award has been passed till date.

4. Learned Counsel for the petitioners further submits that the petitioners having appeared before the authority on 10.01.2024 have also filed objections on 29.04.2024 and the said objections remain to be considered by the authority by passing an Award and since no Award is passed, the respondent authorities may be directed to consider the aforesaid objections filed.

5. Per contra, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 to 4 would submit that the validity of the declaration was extended by a further period of twelve months, vide proceedings dated 24.08.2024 and thus, the authorities are now required to pass Award on or before 24.08.2025.

6. Learned Government Pleader further submits that since the authorities have already issued Award enquiry notice under Section 21 of the Act, the authorities would consider the objections filed by the petitioners as well as the unofficial respondents in respect of the subject land being acquired by the authorities at the time of passing of the Award.

sentences.text:
Having regard to the submissions made as above and taking note of the fact that since no Award has been passed till date though a declaration was issued on 25.08.2023 and the validity of the said declaration having been extended for a further period of twelve months with effect from 25.08.2024 to 24.08.2025, this Court is of the view that the respondent authorities are to be directed to consider the objections filed by the petitioners as well as the unofficial respondents while passing the Award in relation to the subject acquisition and also communicate the Award to the petitioners.
8.
Subject to the above direction, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.

T. VINOD KUMAR, J Date: 07.01.2025 MRKR Kammari Kamala vs The State Of Telangana on 7 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49443264/
